multiplier_counterexample.seed_scope: Every one of the 27 nodes has the stated initial triple.
multiplier_counterexample.interpretation: Giving lambda regular Rule3 inertia turns lambda*(q^2-1) into a force, not exact enforcement of q^2=1. If used as a coframe diag(q,1,1,1), this initial nondegenerate coframe becomes degenerate.

strict_link_support.rejection: strict_support: physical support (link gears span their link) exceeds one node or one face link for 1 monomial(s), e.g. target 'e' with factors [('e', (0, 0, 0), 'b'), ('omega_x', (0, 0, 0), 'b'), ('omega_y', (0, 0, 0), 'b')]
strict_link_support.interpretation: A low-degree term using honest x-link and y-link connections touches three physical vertices and violates the one-edge monomial condition. This tests a term, not a complete gravity law.

scope: Counterexamples to naive constructions, not no-go theorems for prepared invariant sectors, auxiliary encodings, or other discrete gravity actions.
